lyrics:
Our hearts revive in Your truth and in Your life
Your freedom makes me come alive
You take my pain and You give garments of praise
You anoint me with Your joy
In this place
You are the joy of my life

The Spirit of the Lord now gives me strength
To preach the gospel of the King
The blind will see and the captives all will sing
Proclaim a great Jubilee

Full of faith, we sing out
The whole world hears the shout
You are the light and the truth
and I go crazy for You

In Your presence the old is washed away
a new creation, I'm walking in Your ways
Every chain is broken off of me
The love of Jesus now has set me free

I longed for a place to call my home
I met You, face to face
and Your love never leaves
even if the world
So I lift my hands and sing
For You are my victory

In Your embrace I find my peace
I don't have to run, I don't have to fear
and loved by You
So restore my soul
and wash me completely clean

You fight for us
You bore our blame
and You're our Risen King
So all my life I will look on
Thankful with all my heart
that You have brought me

We're gonna worship the King
Praise His name, lift up holy hands

I'm gonna praise Him in the morning
Praise Him in the night, all day long
I'm gonna lift up the mighty name of Jesus
You'll hear me singing His song

I love you, Forever, you.
Though you are small, the vastness of space
Bears no one else I'd love in your place.
By My own hand, so wondrously made
You are My favorite, no one could take your place!

Each day My heart is filled with joy
longing to see your face.
You are My favorite, no one brings joy as you do.
Come let Me be your everything
and bestow blessings on you.
